terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: The rules that apply to everyone on XePrime: renters, individual vehicle owners, and rental shops.

scope.heading: 1. Scope
scope.body: These terms apply whenever you use the XePrime website, app, or any of our services. Creating an account, listing a vehicle, sending a rental request, or continuing to use the platform means you have read and accepted them. If you do not accept them, please stop using the service.

role.heading: 2. What XePrime does and does not do
role.body: XePrime is a marketplace connecting people who need a vehicle with owners and rental shops, and it provides the software they use to run their rental operation.

items.isMarketplace: We run the place where vehicles are listed and searched, requests are sent, and trip records are kept.
items.notLessor: We do not own any vehicle and are not the lessor in any rental.
items.contractBetween: The rental contract is formed directly between the renter and the owner; XePrime is not a party to it.
items.toolsProvided: We provide the tools for locking the calendar and the price, handover records, messaging and support.

account.heading: 3. Your account and its security
account.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of your registration details and for everything done through your account.

items.accurate: Give your real name, phone number and email — these are what we use to reach you when something goes wrong mid-trip.
items.secret: Never share your password or an OTP with anyone, including people claiming to be XePrime staff.
items.report: If you suspect your account has been accessed by someone else, change your password and tell us immediately.
items.oneAccount: One phone number belongs to one account; we may refuse an action if one person uses several accounts to get around a limit.

booking.heading: 4. How a booking is made
booking.body: A trip goes through four steps, and none of them takes your money before the owner agrees. All times are shown in Vietnam time.

items.request: You send a rental request with your time window and where you want the vehicle. This charges nothing and holds nothing — the vehicle stays open to other renters.
items.decision: The shop accepts or declines. Vehicles with instant booking are accepted automatically. Only an acceptance holds the calendar and fixes the price.
items.holdPayment: You transfer the holding amount within the payment window, which runs from the moment the shop accepts and never past the pick-up time. It is 30% of the time between the shop's acceptance and pick-up (at least 15 minutes, at most 120 minutes) — see the Cancellation and Refund Policy. We remind you before it closes. When it closes, it closes; there is no extension.
items.bookingCreated: The booking itself is created only once reconciliation confirms the holding amount arrived in full — not when you press a button or scan a code.
items.slotLost: If the time window has gone to another renter, the remaining requests for it are closed and you are told. This is not the shop declining you.

money.heading: 5. The money in a trip
money.body: When the shop accepts, the system shows every amount before you pay: what you transfer up front, what you pay the owner directly at pick-up, and anything refundable.

items.online: The up-front amount is transferred to the account XePrime shows on the payment screen of that booking. Do not transfer to any other account.
items.atHandover: The rest of the rental is paid directly to the owner when you collect the vehicle. XePrime does not collect it on their behalf.
items.deposit: A security deposit at pick-up, where the shop asks for one, is a separate amount handed over between the two of you and returned at drop-off — it is not the holding amount you transferred earlier.
items.frozen: Every figure and policy that applies to a booking is recorded when the booking is created. Later changes are never applied backwards to it.

owner.heading: 6. Obligations of owners and shops
owner.body: You undertake to list only vehicles you may lawfully rent out, with valid documents and truthful information.

items.rightToRent: List only vehicles you own or are lawfully entitled to rent out.
items.truthful: Describe the model year, condition, price and rental terms accurately; photos must be of that actual vehicle.
items.calendar: Keep the vehicle calendar true to reality so renters do not request windows you cannot honour.
items.respond: Respond to requests within a reasonable time. Your response rate and speed are measured and shown publicly — see the Marketplace Operating Rules.
items.handover: Hand over the vehicle as described, and complete a handover record with condition photos at both ends of the trip.

renter.heading: 7. Obligations of renters
renter.body: You undertake to use the vehicle for its agreed purpose, lawfully, and in line with what you agreed with the owner.

items.licence: Provide valid, in-date identity documents and a valid driving licence.
items.lawfulUse: Do not use the vehicle for anything prohibited by law.
items.noSublet: Do not sub-let the vehicle or hand it to anyone not named in the agreement.
items.careAndCost: You are responsible for damage, traffic violations and costs arising while the vehicle is in your care, as agreed with the owner.

fees.heading: 8. XePrime fees
fees.body: XePrime charges in two ways: a per-trip service fee for owners without a subscription, and a subscription priced by VEHICLE COUNT and term for shops. This is what XePrime earns to run the marketplace, provide support and fight fraud — it is not tax and it is not insurance. Rates, terms and effective dates are published before you confirm; the amounts on a booking already created are never recalculated when the policy changes afterwards.
fees.bodyInApp: XePrime charges service fees according to the published fee schedule for each way owners and shops take part. This is what XePrime earns to run the marketplace, provide support and fight fraud — it is not tax and it is not insurance. Rates and effective dates are published before you confirm; the amounts on a booking already created are never recalculated when the policy changes afterwards.

tax.heading: 9. Tax obligations
tax.body: Tax arising from renting out a vehicle is the owner's or shop's obligation under Vietnamese law. Where the law requires the platform to withhold and remit tax, XePrime will show that amount as its own line, at the actual amount, with its basis stated. XePrime does not label its own fee as tax.

offPlatform.heading: 10. Dealing directly, off the platform
offPlatform.body: Shops may publish their contact details and close deals directly with customers. However, for any part of a transaction not recorded on XePrime we have no data to reconcile, cannot confirm that payment happened, and do not promise refunds or dispute resolution. Please weigh that before agreeing to anything off the platform.

content.heading: 11. Content you upload
content.body: You keep your rights in the photos, descriptions, and other content you post, and you grant XePrime the right to use them to display and promote your listing and to operate the service. You confirm that your content does not infringe anyone else's rights and does not misrepresent the vehicle. XePrime may hide or remove content that breaks these rules, and will tell the poster why.

liability.heading: 12. Limitation of liability
liability.body: XePrime is responsible for operating the platform, for service availability, and for the commitments stated in this document. XePrime is not responsible for the conduct of renters or owners, the actual condition of a vehicle, or losses arising from the rental relationship between the two parties. Nothing here excludes liability that the law does not allow to be excluded.

suspension.heading: 13. Suspension and termination
suspension.body: XePrime may suspend or terminate access where we find fraud, falsified information, unlawful activity, or a serious breach of these terms. Except in an emergency or where a competent authority requires otherwise, we will state the reason and give you a chance to respond. You may stop using the service and ask us to close your account at any time, once outstanding obligations are settled.

changes.heading: 14. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update this document as the product or the law changes. New versions are published on this page with an effective date; changes that materially affect your rights will be announced in advance by email or in-app notice. Bookings already created continue under the policy that applied when they were created.

law.heading: 15. Governing law and disputes
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Vietnam. We ask both parties to try to resolve matters through XePrime's support channel first. If no agreement is reached, the dispute is to be settled by the competent court under Vietnamese law.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: What data XePrime collects, what we use it for, who we share it with, and what rights you have.

scope.heading: 1. Scope
scope.body: This policy explains how XePrime handles personal data belonging to renters, vehicle owners, shop staff, and visitors. It applies to our website, our app, and our support channels.

collected.heading: 2. Data we collect
collected.body: We collect two kinds of data: what you give us, and what is generated as you use the service.

items.provided: You give us: your name, phone number, email, profile photo, vehicle details and vehicle documents, message content and reviews.
items.generated: Generated in use: search and booking history, device and browser, IP address, and access times.
items.documents: Identity documents and driving licences are collected only when you upload them yourself to complete a trip.
items.notCollected: We do not collect biometric data and do not ask for bank card details on the platform at this stage.

purpose.heading: 3. How we use it
purpose.body: We use your data only for the purposes below.

items.account: Creating, verifying and protecting your account.
items.booking: Showing listings, processing rental requests and keeping trip records.
items.support: Communication between the two sides, support and dispute handling.
items.safety: Detecting fraud and protecting other users.
items.improve: Measuring usage in order to improve the product.
items.marketing: Sending marketing — only with your consent, and you can unsubscribe at any time.

sharing.heading: 4. Who we share it with
sharing.body: We share data in the four cases below, and there is no fifth.

items.betweenParties: Once a rental request is accepted, the contact details needed are shared between renter and owner so the trip can happen.
items.processors: With infrastructure, messaging, email and file-storage providers, only as far as running the service requires and under confidentiality obligations.
items.authorities: With state authorities where there is a lawful request.
items.noSale: We do not sell personal data to anyone.

masking.heading: 5. Internal access limits
masking.body: Phone numbers and email addresses shown on internal monitoring screens are always masked. XePrime staff can see the full value only with a specific permission and a business reason, and every such view is logged with who did it and when.

retention.heading: 6. How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep data while your account is active and for as long as we need it to meet legal and accounting obligations and to resolve disputes. Trip records and handover evidence are kept longer than marketing data, because they are the evidence if a complaint is raised.

security.heading: 7. Keeping data safe
security.body: The technical measures currently in place:

items.session: Login sessions use httpOnly cookies that browser JavaScript cannot read.
items.hashing: Passwords and OTPs are stored hashed; the originals are never kept.
items.privateStorage: Documents and sensitive files are kept in private storage, reachable only through time-limited links after the system checks your permissions.

rights.heading: 8. Your rights
rights.body: You have the following rights over your personal data. Send a request through our support channel; we respond within the statutory period, and we say why whenever we have to refuse part of a request.

items.access: To know about and access the data we hold about you.
items.delete: To have data deleted, except what we must keep to meet legal obligations.
items.withdraw: To withdraw consent you gave earlier.
items.complain: To complain about how your data is handled.

cookies.heading: 9. Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your display language, and measure usage so we can improve the product. You can block cookies in your browser, but sign-in will not work if you do.

changes.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: When this policy changes, the new version is published on this page with an effective date. Changes that materially affect how your data is used will be announced in advance.

marketplace-rules.title: Marketplace Operating Rules
marketplace-rules.summary: How the XePrime marketplace runs: who may join, how listings are approved, how breaches are handled, and how to raise a complaint.

purpose.heading: 1. Purpose and who this covers
purpose.body: These rules set out how the XePrime marketplace operates and apply to the platform operator, to owners and shops that list vehicles, and to renters. They are issued under Vietnamese e-commerce law and form an inseparable part of the Terms of Service.

members.heading: 2. Who may sell
members.body: A seller must be an individual with legal capacity or a lawfully established organisation, must give truthful identifying information, and must hold the legal right to rent out the vehicles they list. XePrime may ask for further documents and may refuse or suspend membership where the file does not meet these requirements.

listing.heading: 3. Listing and approval
listing.body: A vehicle only appears publicly after both the shop profile and the vehicle file have been approved by XePrime. A listing must use real photos of the vehicle and give accurate information about model year, condition, price, and rental conditions. A rejected listing always comes with a reason, and the seller can fix it and resubmit.

prohibited.heading: 4. Prohibited content and behaviour
prohibited.body: The following are prohibited on the marketplace and may lead to a listing being removed, visibility being restricted, or membership being terminated.

items.noRight: Listing a vehicle you have no right to rent out.
items.stolenPhotos: Using someone else's photos, or photos that are not of the listed vehicle.
items.falsePrice: Misstating the price, model year, condition or rental terms.
items.duplicate: Listing one vehicle repeatedly to take up search results.
items.unlawful: Using the platform for unlawful activity or to defraud.
items.harassment: Harassing, threatening or insulting other users.
items.scraping: Collecting user data for any purpose other than carrying out a trip, by any means.

ranking.heading: 5. Ranking and placement
ranking.body: Search results are ordered by how well a vehicle fits what the customer asked for: location, dates, vehicle type, availability, price, completeness of the listing, and service quality. Within a group of comparable results, subscribing shops may receive a ranking boost. Any sponsored or commercially prioritised placement is clearly labelled; XePrime does not push an unsuitable or low-quality vehicle to the top.

transaction.heading: 6. How a transaction works
transaction.body: A trip on the marketplace passes five points, and what each one causes is written into the trip record.

items.request: The renter sends a request with a time window and pick-up preference. The request charges nothing and takes no calendar.
items.decision: The shop accepts or declines. Acceptance is what holds the vehicle calendar, fixes the price and issues the amount payable to the renter.
items.holdPayment: The renter transfers the holding amount within the payment window. If it expires, the slot is released and other requests for the same window reopen.
items.bookingCreated: The booking is created when reconciliation confirms the money arrived in full. Its price and policy are recorded at that moment and do not follow later configuration changes.
items.handover: Both sides complete a handover record with condition photos, and a return record at drop-off. This is the evidence used if a complaint arises.

metrics.heading: 7. Shop reputation metrics
metrics.body: The marketplace measures and publicly shows three metrics for every shop: request response rate, response time, and the rate of trips accepted and kept. They are calculated over the last 90 days and shown only once there are at least 5 qualifying cases — below that we leave them blank rather than display a figure with no statistical meaning. Cases where the shop had no opportunity to decide — the window had already gone to another renter, or the renter withdrew before the shop replied — are not counted.

fees.heading: 8. Marketplace fees
fees.body: The marketplace charges a per-trip service fee to owners without a subscription, or a subscription priced by VEHICLE COUNT and term to shops. The fee schedule, terms and effective dates are published in advance; any change applies only to bookings created after the new effective date. Marketplace fees are shown separately from tax obligations and from amounts payable to the owner.
fees.bodyInApp: The marketplace charges service fees according to the published fee schedule for each way owners and shops take part. The fee schedule and effective dates are published in advance; any change applies only to bookings created after the new effective date. Marketplace fees are shown separately from tax obligations and from amounts payable to the owner.

violation.heading: 9. Handling breaches
violation.body: Depending on severity, XePrime may issue a warning, require a correction, hide a listing, reduce visibility, suspend a shop, or terminate membership. Anyone subject to these measures is told the reason and may respond. Conduct that appears unlawful is referred to the competent authority.

items.remind: A reminder and a request to correct the listing.
items.demote: Restricting the shop's visibility in search results.

dispute.heading: 10. Reports and dispute resolution
dispute.body: Reports, complaints, and disputes are received through the support channel published on the Support page. We log, triage, and respond in the order received, prioritising incidents happening during a live trip. XePrime helps by supplying the trip record as evidence; for any part of a transaction not recorded in the system, we have no data on which to adjudicate.

privacyRef.heading: 11. Protection of personal data
privacyRef.body: Collection and processing of members' personal data follows the Privacy Policy published alongside these rules. Members must not use another user's information for anything other than completing a rental.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
cancellation.summary: Who can cancel at which stage, what it costs you when, and how the money is handled.

principle.heading: 1. General principle
principle.body: The deadlines and cancellation terms for a trip are fixed the moment the shop accepts it, and are shown to both sides before you transfer any money. Later policy changes are never applied backwards to a trip already fixed. All times are in Vietnam time.

beforeDecision.heading: 2. Before the shop accepts
beforeDecision.body: Sending a request charges nothing and holds nothing. You may withdraw it at any time before the shop decides, at no cost, and that withdrawal does not count against the shop’s reputation metrics.

paymentWindow.heading: 3. The payment and free-cancellation windows
paymentWindow.body: Once the shop accepts, you get a window to transfer the holding amount. When the full holding amount arrives, the trip becomes a booking and only then does the free-cancellation window start. Both windows scale with the time left until pick-up and never run past pick-up. Current terms:

items.payment: The payment window is 30% of the time between the shop's acceptance and pick-up, at least 15 minutes and at most 120 minutes — with pick-up about 7 hours or more away you get the full 120 minutes.
items.cancel: Free cancellation starts when your payment succeeds and lasts 20% of the time from then until pick-up, at least 15 minutes and at most 2 hours — paying 10 hours or more before pick-up gives you the full 2 hours. The closer to pick-up you pay, the shorter the free-cancellation window.
items.tooShort: Neither deadline ever runs past pick-up. If too little time is left to pay (under 15 minutes), the trip cannot be held through XePrime.
items.expiry: We remind you before the payment window closes. If the full amount has not arrived by then, the request is cancelled automatically: the slot is released to other renters and the trip does not go ahead; anything you already transferred is refunded in full to your Points wallet. The payment window cannot be extended.

freeCancel.heading: 4. Free cancellation
freeCancel.body: After you have transferred the full holding amount, you may cancel and have 100% of it refunded to your Points wallet if you cancel before your trip's free-cancellation deadline (section 3). That deadline is fixed once, the moment the full holding amount arrives: the shop moving the pick-up time does not change it. Before you pay you see how long free cancellation would last if you paid now; after you pay, the exact deadline is shown with a countdown.

afterFreeCancel.heading: 5. Cancelling after the free-cancellation deadline
afterFreeCancel.body: Cancelling after the free-cancellation deadline, or cancelling after paying for a trip that has no free-cancellation window, works as follows. The cancellation dialog always shows what will and will not be refunded before you confirm.

items.insurance: Any insurance you chose is refunded 100% to your Points wallet, because the policy is only issued at pick-up.
items.split: The whole holding amount except the insurance — the booking fee and the rent paid in advance — is not refunded: the owner is compensated for holding the car for you, and the remainder goes to XePrime.
items.noShow: Not turning up without notice is treated as cancelling after the free-cancellation deadline.
items.direct: The part payable directly to the owner at pick-up has not been paid yet, so there is nothing to refund there.

ownerCancel.heading: 6. When the owner cancels
ownerCancel.body: What an owner may do depends on the stage, and the later the stage the heavier the consequence for the renter — so the rules tighten accordingly.

items.beforeDecision: Not yet decided: the shop may DECLINE the request. Nobody loses money, because none has moved.
items.beforePayment: Accepted but not yet paid in full: the shop may cancel the trip. The calendar is released and anything you already transferred is refunded in full to your Points wallet.
items.afterBooking: Already a booking: if the shop cancels, you are refunded 100% of what you transferred to your Points wallet — even after the free-cancellation deadline — and the cancellation is recorded against the shop's reputation metrics.
items.duringTrip: Trip in progress: it cannot be cancelled. The vehicle is out on the road with the renter, so ending early has to go through the return handover and settlement.

force.heading: 7. Force majeure
force.body: Natural disasters, epidemics, road closures, an accident occurring before pickup, or a decision by a state authority count as events beyond control. In these cases the two sides should reschedule or cancel without charge; XePrime will help confirm the situation based on evidence both sides provide.

refund.heading: 8. How refunds are made
refund.body: What is refunded is the amount you transferred to XePrime, credited straight to the Points wallet of the account that booked the trip (1 point = 1 VND, never expires); you can withdraw your Points wallet to a bank account at any time. The part paid directly to the owner at pick-up, and any security deposit, are handed over between the two of you and so are settled between the two of you. If you used a XePrime promo code, the refund does not include the value of that code — it is a platform-funded discount, not money you paid.

dispute.heading: 9. When the two of you disagree
dispute.body: Send a report through the Help centre with the trip code and your evidence: in-app messages, the handover records and the condition photos. We compare them against the trip record in our system and give a supporting conclusion within the limits of the data we hold. For anything the two of you settled off the platform, we have no data to reconcile.

owner-tax.title: Tax policy for owners
owner-tax.summary: XePrime withholds, declares and pays tax on behalf of owners who are individuals or household businesses: the rates, what they apply to, when they are deducted and what you need to do.

basis.heading: 1. Legal basis
basis.body: XePrime withholds tax from owners because the law requires it — it is not a XePrime fee. The regulations in force:

items.nd117: Decree 117/2025/ND-CP (effective 1 July 2025): digital platforms with a payment function must withhold, declare and pay value-added tax (VAT) and personal income tax (PIT) on behalf of households and individuals doing business on the platform.
items.nd68: Decree 68/2026/ND-CP (effective 5 March 2026): platforms with ordering and payment functions continue to withhold, declare and pay on behalf of sellers per transaction; PIT paid on your behalf is credited when you finalise your taxes.
items.platform: XePrime collects the customer's hold payment through its own account, so it is a platform with a payment function and must withhold and pay on your behalf.

who.heading: 2. Who is withheld
who.body: Whether tax is withheld depends only on the entity type in your seller profile:

items.company: Company verified by XePrime: not withheld — a company issues its own invoices and declares its own taxes.
items.noProfile: No seller profile yet, or a company profile not yet verified: treated as an individual and withheld. Missing information does not remove the tax obligation.
items.track: Being on a subscription plan or not does not decide withholding: a shop that buys a plan but is a household business is still withheld.

itemsInApp.track: How an owner participates on the marketplace does not decide withholding: an owner registered as a household business is still withheld.

rates.heading: 3. Rates
rates.body: The rate depends on the trip's service type and is made of two taxes computed separately. Current rates:

items.snapshot: The rate of a trip is locked in when you accept it. If the rates change later, trips already locked in keep the old rate.

base.heading: 4. What the tax applies to
base.body: Tax is computed on the rental amount of the trip:

items.included: Included: the rental after any discount you set on the vehicle.
items.excluded: Excluded: the delivery fee (the customer pays it to you directly), the booking fee the customer pays XePrime, insurance and the value of promo codes funded by XePrime.
items.rounding: Each tax is computed separately and rounded to the đồng, so the amount withheld matches the rate times the rental exactly. Example: a 780,000đ self-drive trip is withheld VAT 39,000đ + PIT 15,600đ = 54,600đ.

timing.heading: 5. When tax is withheld
timing.body: Tax follows the trips that actually take place:

items.recorded: The tax is recorded when the trip starts, that is when the vehicle is handed over to the customer.
items.deducted: The tax is deducted from what XePrime pays you: when the trip is completed, your Points wallet receives your share of the hold payment minus the tax. Tax is never added to what the customer pays.
items.adjusted: If the amount of a trip changes after the tax was recorded, XePrime records a reversal and a new entry instead of editing the old one.

cancellation.heading: 6. When a trip is cancelled
cancellation.body: A cancellation creates no tax for the part of the trip that did not happen:

items.beforeTrip: Trip cancelled before it starts: no tax withheld.
items.lateCompensation: The compensation you receive when a customer cancels late or does not show up is compensation, not rental revenue, so it is not withheld.

threshold.heading: 7. Revenue of 500 million đồng a year or less
threshold.body: Under Decree 68/2026/ND-CP, households and individuals with annual revenue of 500 million đồng or less do not have to pay VAT and PIT. The platform still has to withhold per transaction because it cannot know your full-year revenue in advance. If you are not liable for the year, contact your tax authority to have the amount paid on your behalf refunded or offset, using the withholding certificate XePrime provides.

identity.heading: 8. Information you need to provide
identity.body: So that XePrime declares the right taxpayer, complete your seller profile: entity type, full name or household business name, and tax code or citizen ID number. Wrong or missing information may prevent the tax paid on your behalf from being credited to you correctly.

certificate.heading: 9. Withholding certificate
certificate.body: XePrime will provide the year's tax withholding certificate before the tax finalisation period, for you to use when finalising your taxes or requesting a refund. Until then, you can see the tax withheld for each trip and per month in your workspace.

statement.heading: 10. Where you see the amounts
statement.body: In the request approval dialog, the booking detail and the wallet statement, the "owner payout" table shows each line separately: rental revenue, the owner service fee, tax withheld (with the VAT and PIT parts), your income, the part the customer pays you directly and the amount credited to your wallet.

changes.heading: 11. Policy changes
changes.body: The rates and how they apply may change with new legislation or tax authority guidance. Changes are published on this page before they apply and never apply retroactively to trips already locked in.
